Skills · Yinyang Empty

Empty: files and updates

The collection retains Full at skills/yinyang/ as a static reference of the website's philosophy in Skill form, not for loading into your own practice. skills/yinyang-empty/ is Empty, the practice package: the shared dialectical core, six formation guides, selected suggestions, and practical method entrances. Both are complete packages for their stated use. Neither public edition includes anyone's private personal accounts. Empty includes unfilled Personal and Situated starters, for formation in a private copy.

Empty has no docs/ or diagrams/ tree. Its references/formation/ contains the six guides in both languages. references/ also holds Core views, practice overview, formation and revision, Personal organization, and this package guide. The entrypoint owns daily collaboration. Links to the author's essays are optional website reading, not missing package dependencies or an instruction to fetch the entire philosophy before working.

Keep these recipient-owned materials private and outside managed plugin caches:

Place Responsibility
references/philosophy/ or an existing private source Your philosophical writing and selected positions.
references/personal/ Your relevant materials, evidence, maintained interpretations, and source index.
references/situated/ Your binding index, generated model bodies, and actual revision method.

The six status: unfilled starters live at references/situated/{orientation,person,counterpart,relationship,environment,revision}.md. Form their content through the simple or complex route in the reference and method overview, retaining versions in private Git/GitHub. The complex route can project results to these files or bind all six complete bodies through a private index; see Hindsight configuration.

Personal's four areas hold readable topic articles, with the source index linking to originals. Formation and revision explains grounded condensation, whole-account checking, and updates.

Obtain and use the edition

In Codex, select yinyang-empty@boluopai through the collection's installation guide. For a source-based installation, use the complete skills/yinyang-empty/ directory. GitHub's repository ZIP contains both editions and the website source; the entire repository is not one installable Skill. The generated plugins/yinyang-empty/ wraps this same Empty package for Codex.

For a Web or another client, use its actual supported Skill or file mechanism, then verify that the current conversation can read the entrypoint and needed references. A website link or a downloaded ZIP alone does not establish this. If forming a personal version, copy the complete method package to a privately maintained source, form the actual material there, and enable that version through the client's real discovery route. Avoid competing Full, Empty, and personal entrypoints for the same collaboration.

Update the method without replacing the person

Take updates from skills/yinyang-empty/, not from Full. Compare the new method files with the private source, apply the relevant common changes, then verify the private consumer. Preserve references/philosophy/, references/personal/, references/situated/, their links, and independently authored additions. When a common method has also been locally adapted, compare the meanings instead of silently overwriting it. Do not run Full's whole-package sync-common.py against an Empty version; it belongs to Full's different file contract.

The collection maintainer uses scripts/build-yinyang-empty.py --apply to refresh the shared guides from Full, rebase their links, and adapt the distribution statement to Empty's unfilled six actual starters. Its default mode checks that the generated selection is current. Empty's own entrypoint and package guidance remain authored at this directory. Plugin generation then packages that exact tree. This publication operation does not read or update recipient personal data.

Questionnaire and assessment material

When relevant completed measurements exist, organize their references in references/personal/psychology/, adding a questionnaires/ subdirectory when the collection needs it. Use an index to connect dated records, original answers or reports, and their existing private owners. Link it from personal/README.md and personal/sources.md. An existing private archive can keep its own layout; the four areas need not duplicate or move all originals. The starters contain no records or assessment results.

Retain known instrument, language and version, completion date and context, results and score direction, and the original record's location. Distinguish questionnaire responses, performance tests, reported conclusions, and later interpretations; missing answers or dates remain unknown. A measurement is bounded evidence, not a complete person or a reason to adopt a philosophical claim. This organization supplies no scoring, diagnostic, or treatment method.
